title: Federated-Learning (PyTorch)
summary: A PyTorch implementation of the federated learning algorithm from 'Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data', extended to train on tabular datasets (e.g. abalone) alongside the standard MNIST/CIFAR image experiments. The repo vendors and modifies an in-tree copy of SDV (as sdv_local) and a copy of ctgan, and its baseline_main.py directly instantiates CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to generate synthetic tabular training data.
evidence: src/baseline_main.py:160-170: global_model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, train_dataset, cuda=True, epochs=300) / TVAESynthesizer(...)
needs: sdv_local and src/ctgan are heavily modified vendored copies of sdv/ctgan; unclear whether other vendored subpackages (PAR, GaussianCopula, HMA) are ever actually invoked beyond the CTGAN/TVAE call sites shown.
